name: Finance Tracker
tagline: Track income, expenses, and monthly category budgets
description: A local financial ledger tool. Actions: add_transaction (needs type, amount, category, description, date), get_summary (needs start_date, end_date, category), list_transactions (needs limit, type, category), delete_transaction (needs id), set_budget (needs category, limit), get_budgets.

type.description: Required for add_transaction. Type of the transaction.

amount.description: Required for add_transaction. The numeric value of the transaction.

category.description: Required for set_budget, optional for add_transaction, get_summary, list_transactions. The budget/expense category (e.g., Food, Entertainment, Salary).

description.description: Optional for add_transaction. A brief description of the transaction.

date.description: Optional for add_transaction. Date format YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to current date if omitted.

start_date.description: Optional for get_summary. Filter summary starting from YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Optional for get_summary. Filter summary ending on YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Required for set_budget, optional limit count for list_transactions.

id.description: Required for delete_transaction. The unique transaction ID.
